svg.title: 05a · Security Architecture: As-Is
svg.desc: Left: exposure map of the single Docker host with a flat network, published ports, plain HTTP between FSPs and the switch, Kafka PLAINTEXT and databases without TLS. Right: twelve control layers with their status. Bottom: the separate SDK-to-SDK security harness with mTLS and JWS, and the locations of committed test secrets (contents not reproduced).
svg.text: What this repository configures for security, layer by layer. The harness is deliberately open for testing: never copy these settings into a shared environment.
one flat network: every container reaches every other
TTK signs requests (JWS); SDKs do not
No client certificates, no OAuth tokens
PLAINTEXT listeners · no SASL · no ACLs
no TLS · no encryption at rest
MongoDB, Redis, the TTK and the
Flat bridge network; no network policies, firewall rules or egress control
None between services; Kafka PLAINTEXT; outbound HTTPS only if an FSP URL is https
None. Placeholder Authorization headers in tests are not checked
FSPIOP-Source must be a registered, active participant (3100 / 3201); spoofable without mTLS +
Switch signs its messages (JWS_SIGN true, key from docker/secrets/); FSP signatures
Headers, schema, Date weekday (3100–3102), duplicates (3106), expiry (3303), ILP condition
Net Debit Cap and liquidity checks (4200 / 4001 → ABORTED_REJECTED); participant deactivation
None deployed. Off: SDK OAuth2 client, TTK OAuth / Keycloak / Connection Manager, reporting Ory
Test keys, certificates and passwords committed to Git (test only; locations below)
No encryption at rest; DB root with empty password allowed; MongoDB and Redis without auth
Containers as root; some unpinned latest tags (exporters, Kafka UI, cAdvisor)
Grype image scanning in CI with an ignore list; SBOM published per release
measures mTLS + JWS overhead between two SDKs
Peer JWS public key in verification_keys/
Committed test secrets (locations only; contents not reproduced)
docker/security/{payer,payee}/: FSP JWS keys, TLS keys, CA private keys
TTK default-env.json and user_config.json: embedded simulator JWS keys and client certificate data
envs/*-sdk.env: sample ILP_SECRET, OAuth test client credentials · docker-compose.yml, docker/grafana/config.env: default passwords
Sources: config overrides, compose files, envs/*.env, TTK system_config.json, reporting API config, lab verification. Target design: 05b.
